title: Orange Fluff I
description: Orange flavored gelatin is stirred into whipped topping and then folded into a bowl of cottage cheese, crushed pineapple and mandarin oranges. Even better when chilled for an hour.
ingredients: 2 (3 ounce) packages orange flavored Jell-O® mix
1 (16 ounce) package frozen whipped topping, thawed

steps.text: Combine the well drained oranges and pineapple in a large bowl and mix together with the cottage cheese. Add the dry orange flavored gelatin powder and stir until well blended. Fold in the thawed frozen whipped topping and refrigerate for at least one hour.

video.description: This video shows you how to make a classic Orange Fluff Jello Salad, a cool and creamy no-bake dessert. This light and fruity recipe combines mandarin oranges, pineapple, cottage cheese, and orange Jell-O mix. Learn the simple steps to create this retro dessert that's perfect for potlucks or any family gathering.
